mapper.insert: insert into kb_provider_credentials(provider_account_id, credential_type, encrypted_key, encrypted_secret, token_value, encrypted_config, expire_at, status) values(#{providerId}, #{credentialType}, #{encryptedKey}, #{encryptedSecret}, #{tokenValue}, #{encryptedConfig}, #{expireAt}, #{status})
